blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Based on the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition of reflection symmetric polarimetric SAR data we present a version for full/quad polarisation data. We demonstrate both versions on X-band F-SAR data over Vejers, Denmark. Differences between the original and our version of the decomposition occur especially for very bright man-made targets. These differences come with lower entropy for our version giving an improved focus on a more pronounced dominant scattering mechanism for these objects. Interpretation of the scattering mechanism related to the full/quad pol version of the decomposition is facilitated by means of the Cloude/Pottier $\barα$ angle.
blocks.zh: 基于Cloude/van Zyl 反射对称极性合成孔径雷达数据的分解,我们提出了全方位极化数据的版本。 我们用X波段F-SAR数据在丹麦的Vejers上演示两个版本. 原版和我们版本的分解特别针对非常明亮的人造目标. 这些差异与我们版本的低等离子体相比,使得人们更加关注这些物体的更显著的散射机制。 通过Cloude/Pottier $\barα$角度,有助于解释与整/整波尔分解版本有关的散射机制。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In ( van Zyl 1993 ) van Zyl describes what he calls the Cloude decomposition ( Cloude 1992 ) for polarimetric synthetic aperture radar (SAR) data.
The Cloude decomposition is the general spectral decomposition
consisting of sums of products of eigenvalues (sorted non-increasingly) and outer products of the corresponding eigenvectors of the
Hermitian 3 × \times 3 covariance matrix of multilook SAR data.
In ( van Zyl
et al. 2011 ) which deals primarily with another subject, namely an improvement of the Freeman/Durden decomposition ( Freeman and
Durden 1998 ) ,
the decomposition in ( van Zyl 1993 ) for reflection symmetric data is described further with an explicit distinction between single and double bounce
(dihedral)
targets.
Inspired by this work we here give a version of the decomposition for full/quad pol SAR data.
blocks.zh:
在(van Zyl 1993)中,van Zyl描述了他所称的用于极度合成孔径雷达数据的云分解(Cloude 1992).
云分解是一般光谱分解
由具有等值(种类不增高)的产品和相应产品的外部产品组成
Hermitian 3 ×\times 3 多视合成孔径雷达数据的共变矩阵。
在(范齐尔)
后者主要处理另一个问题,即改进Freeman/Duden分解(Freeman和Freeman)
Durden 1998), (中文(简体) ).
(van Zyl 1993)中用于反射对称数据的分解进一步描述,明确区分单弹跳和双弹跳
(双面)
目标。
在这项工作的启发下,我们在此给出了完整/quad POLSAR数据的分解版本.

blocks.en:
For both the original, reflection symmetry and the full/quad pol versions of the decomposition,
the eigenvalues needed are calculated by means of fast methods described in ( Uspensky 1948 ; Nielsen 2020 ) .
blocks.zh:
对于原始的,反射的对称性 和完整的/quad pol 版本的分解,
需要的eigen值通过快速方法计算(Uspensky,1948年;Nielsen,2020年)。

blocks.en:
Shortcomings in the van Zyl decomposition relating to asymmetric scattering are dealt with in ( Bhattacharaya and
Touzi 2011 ) ,
and the single/double bounce dichotomy for full pol covariance matrices in ( Cui et al. 2014 ) .
In this paper these issues are not addressed further.
blocks.zh:
van Zyl分解中与不对称散射有关的缺陷得到处理(Bhattachalaya和Bhattachalaya)。
图兹2011 , ,
以及用于全波尔共变矩阵的单反双反双双(Cui等人,2014年)。
本文件没有进一步讨论这些问题。

blocks.en:
The data used here to illustrate the decompositions are X-band data from the
F-SAR system ( Reigber et al. 2013 ) from the German Aerospace Center (DLR)
covering a small area in western Denmark.

德国航空航天中心F-SAR系统(Reigber等人,2013年)
覆盖丹麦西部的一个小地区。

blocks.en: 3.2 Full/Quad Pol
blocks.zh: 3.2 完全/四方

blocks.en:
For full/quad pol we have the full covariance matrix 𝑪 {C} = \displaystyle= [ ξ a ρ a ∗ η b ρ ∗ b ∗ ζ ] \displaystyle\left[\begin{array}[]{ccc}\xi&a&\rho\\
a^{*}&\eta&b\\
\rho^{*}&b^{*}&\zeta\\
\end{array}\right] and the eigenvalues are found as described in ( Uspensky 1948 ; Nielsen 2020 ) .
The solutions given in ( Nielsen 2020 ) are well suited for fast array based computer implementation.

In this full/quad pol case the third eigenvalue, λ 3 \lambda_{3} , is the one closest to η = 2 ​ ⟨ S h ​ v ​ S h ​ v ∗ ⟩ \eta=2\langle S_{hv}S_{hv}^{*}\rangle .

blocks.en:
One could argue that in the full/quad pol case unlike in the reflection symmetry case, the eigenvectors do not have direct interpretations as being associated with specific scattering mechanisms (single bounce, double bounce, volume scattering).
On the other hand
the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition for reflection symmetric data places restrictions on the data before the decomposition—especially, man-made objects certainly do not exhibit reflection symmetry—whereas what we do here challenges the interpretation after the decomposition.

用于反射对称数据的Cloude/van Zyl分解在分解前对数据设置了限制——特别是人造物体当然不显示反射对称——而我们在这里对分解后的解释提出质疑。

blocks.en: 4 Data example
blocks.zh: 页:1 数据示例

blocks.en:
In a project headed by the
Danish Ministry of Defence Acquisition and Logistics Organization
(DALO) the F-SAR
system of the German Aerospace Center (DLR) has been used to acquire data at several locations in Denmark and Greenland.
The F-SAR offers
the possibility of exploring the performance of a high resolution,
fully polarimetric SAR system with five frequency
bands in the range ∼ \sim 300 MHz to ∼ \sim 10 GHz ( Reigber et al. 2013 ) .
blocks.zh:
在由欧洲联盟领导的一个项目中,
丹麦国防部采购和后勤组织
(DALO) F-SAR号
德国航空航天中心(德国航天中心)的系统被用于获取丹麦和格陵兰几个地点的数据。
F-SAR提议
探讨高清决议执行情况的可能性,
5个频率的完全极性合成孔径雷达系统
范围为 \\ sim 300 MHz 至\ sim 10 GHz 的波段(Reigber等人,2013年)。

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Part of Vejers, Denmark, approximately the area covered by the F-SAR data, from Google Earth.
We see summer houses, caravan sites with a swimming pool and service buildings (a grocery store, a petrol station etc.), the main road called Vejers Havvej (where the text “Vejers” appears) going mostly east-west, dirt roads, vegetation etc.
Note the two red circles in the left part of the image, top-center (near a swimming pool) and bottom (a big house).

The decompositions are illustrated
with airborne F-SAR X-band data (frequency 9.60 GHz corresponding to a wavelength of ∼ \sim 3 cm).
The data were acquired on 20 June 2017
covering a central part of the village Vejers on the Danish west coast, Figure 1 .
The scene covers the east-west main road (called Vejers Havvej where the text “Vejers” appears in Figure 1 and depicted in black in Figures 2 and 3 ) going to and from the sea, camp sites with caravans to the south of the road, a swimming pool, parking lots and several service buildings (grocery store, petrol station etc.) as well as many small and big houses north and south of the road.
Note the two red circles.

Figure 4: Entropy (in the interval [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ) for the original reflection symmetry decomposition minus entropy ( [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] ) for the full/quad pol version.
Differences are consistently nonnegative, i.e, we always have lower entropy for the full/quad pol version.
Large differences (up to 0.62 0.62 ) are concentrated on bright man-made objects (houses, caravans etc.).

因此,所建议的版本减少了这些物体的目标散射机制障碍。

blocks.en:
In Figures 2 and 3 in which square roots of the eigenvalues are shown as RGB,
red objects
are mainly buildings which are characterized by double bounce reflection.
Green objects in the two images are mainly
characterized by volume scattering typically vegetation
or dihedral targets which are rotated with respect to the flight line.
Blue areas in the two images are objects which are characterized by single bounce reflection.
Magenta is a mix of red and blue and therefore magenta objects represent a combination of double and single bounce reflection.
Yellow is a mix of red and green and therefore yellow objects represent a combination of double bounce reflection and volume scattering.
Cyan is a mix of green and blue and therefore cyan objects represent a combination of volume
scattering and single bounce reflection.
White and gray objects represent
a combination of
all three types of scattering.

blocks.en:
In a few places differences between the two decompositions can be seen (two examples are marked by red circles in Figure 1 ).
For example a large whitish trapezoid-shaped roof of the circled building to the bottom-left in Figure 2 appears more yellow in Figure 3 .
This means that our version of the decomposition suggests two scattering mechanisms as opposed to three for the original one.
Also, two yellow building parts (also circled) just south of Vejers Havvej in the middle-left part of Figure 2 immediately left of the swimming pool seen in Figure 1 are red in Figure 3 .
This means that our version of the decomposition suggests one scattering mechanism as opposed to two for the original one.
Similar considerations are valid also for other targets not mentioned here.
blocks.zh:
在少数地方可以看到两种分解的区别(图1中的两个例子以红色圆圈为标志).
例如,在图2中,在图3中,环绕的建筑物到左下方的大型圆形屋顶显得比较黄色。
这意味着我们的分解版本建议了两种散射机制,而原来的一种则建议了三种散射机制.
另外,图2中左侧的Vejers Havvej以南的两块黄色建筑部分(也盘旋)在图3中为红色。
这意味着,我们版本的分解表示一种散射机制,而不是原始机制的两种。
类似的考虑也适用于此处未提及的其他目标。

这意味着建议的完整矩阵
版本给出更少

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We propose
a version of the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition for full/quad pol synthetic aperture radar data.
The Cloude/van Zyl decomposition for reflection symmetric data
offers direct interpretation of the eigenvectors as being associated with single bounce, double bounce or volume scattering
but places restrictions on the data before the decomposition, especially, man-made objects certainly do not exhibit reflection symmetry.
Contrary to this,
since the eigenvectors in the full/quad pol case do not have direct interpretations as being associated with the same specific scattering mechanisms,
what we do here challenges the interpretation after the decomposition.
To facilitate interpretation of the scattering mechanism in this case we use the α ¯ \bar{\alpha} angle.
blocks.zh:
我们提议
用于完整/quad波尔合成孔径雷达数据的Cloude/van Zyl分解版本。
Cloude/van Zyl 反射对称数据的分解
直接解释与单弹跳、双弹跳或体积散射有关
但是在分解前对数据设置限制,特别是人造物体当然不会表现出反射对称.
与此相反,
由于在完全/夸德Pol案中的编辑者没有直接解释与同样的具体分散机制有关,
我们在这里做什么,挑战 解析后的解释。
为了方便解释这个案子的散射机制 我们用一个角度

blocks.en:
The
explicit distinction between single and double bounce
targets in the original reflection symmetry Cloude/van Zyl decomposition
obtained by sorting the first two eigenvalues
according to whether the phase of ⟨ S h ​ h ​ S v ​ v ∗ ⟩ \langle S_{hh}S_{vv}^{*}\rangle is closer to 0 0 or to ± π \pm\pi ,
is retained in this full/quad pol version.
blocks.zh:
这个
明确区分单弹和双弹
原反射对称云/van Zyl分解中的目标
通过排序前两个元值获得
根据XQS h h S v v 的阶段是否接近 0 或 ±\ pm\pi,
保留在这个完整/平方 POL 版本中。

blocks.en:
In the case given,
differences between our version and the original decomposition based
on reflection symmetry occur especially for bright, man-made objects.
With our version these objects have consistently lower entropy.
Hence the suggested version gives less target scattering mechanism disorder for these objects.
This is depicted also in the visualizations shown, e.g., white objects for reflection symmetry to yellow objects for full/quad pol, or yellow to red objects.

反射对称 特别是对于明亮的人造物体

因此,所建议的版本减少了这些物体的目标散射机制障碍。
这在所显示的可视化中也被描绘出来,例如,用于反射对称的白色物体为黄色物体为全/quad pol,或黄色物体为红色物体.
